Maintenance

Oil & filter serviceRoutine care for the miles ahead.

Plan an oil and filter change around your vehicle, mileage and service history.

Scheduled maintenanceA plan around your car.

Review the maintenance your car is due for, with its model, age and mileage in mind.

Fluid checks & serviceSmall details. Important protection.

Discuss fluid condition, service intervals and any concerns with levels or leaks.

Vehicle condition checksKnow what needs attention.

Bring together a picture of visible wear, maintenance needs and the concerns you have noticed.

Diagnostics & repair

Check-engine lightsStart with an explanation.

Tell us which warning appeared, when it started and whether the car feels different. Discuss the next diagnostic steps.

Engine diagnosticsUnderstand what has changed.

Discuss rough running, unusual sounds, starting problems or a change in performance before planning repairs.

Electrical diagnosticsFind a clearer way forward.

Describe intermittent electrical concerns, warning messages or accessories that are not behaving as expected.

Battery & charging checksFor a more confident start.

Plan a check for slow cranking, a flat battery or a charging-system warning.

Oil & fluid leak diagnosisTrace the source.

Discuss new drips, fluid loss or a burning smell, with inspection and diagnosis before a repair recommendation.

Brakes, suspension & steering

Brake pads & rotorsLook after the way it stops.

Discuss brake wear, noise, vibration or a change in pedal feel and plan an inspection.

Brake fluid serviceCare beyond the visible parts.

Review brake-fluid service needs alongside the age, history and condition of your vehicle.

Suspension checks & repairKeep the connection to the road.

Describe clunks, changes in ride quality or uneven tire wear so the next checks can be planned.

Steering concernsA more considered diagnosis.

Discuss changes in steering feel, vibration, pulling or unusual sounds before deciding on repairs.

Cooling & air conditioning

Cooling-system checksKeep temperature in perspective.

Plan checks for coolant loss, leaks or changes in operating temperature.

Overheating diagnosisGet to the cause.

Discuss temperature warnings and when they occur so the cooling system can be assessed.

Air-conditioning diagnosisComfort for Houston driving.

Describe weak cooling, unusual noises or inconsistent airflow and discuss the right checks.

Inspections

Pre-purchase inspectionsBefore the car becomes yours.

Discuss an inspection of a car you are considering, including visible condition, service history and questions for the seller.

Pre-trip condition checksA little preparation for the road.

Review maintenance needs and the concerns you want checked before a longer drive.
